# Copilot pointer

Read `AGENTS.md` before making changes. It is the single source of truth for scope,
design constraints, testing, save safety, and completion reports. Before changing a
system, read the relevant vision, design-principle, architecture, ADR, and system-spec
documents under `docs/`.

Keep this file short and refer back to `AGENTS.md`. It must not become a competing
rulebook or duplicate the project's rules.
